basic_info.description: Looking for an epic beach house? Spanning almost 2400sqft, this move in ready home is so close to Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, many vibrant, fun, local businesses, and hubs of the Sunset Community. Inside, a bright, expansive living space flows into a stylish kitchen with bar seating perfect entertaining. 3 bedrooms and 3 full baths upstairs offer space without compromise. French doors open from the large primary suite to a sunny office overlooking the large, manicured backyard featuring two putting greens. The downstairs is seamlessly integrated, with 2 additional bedrooms, a full bath, laundry room, outdoor shower, and a deep 2-car tandem garage (plenty of storage for surfboards, bikes, and gear). Convenient access to N Judah, Lincoln Way, and Lower Great Highway keeps city commutes easy. So close to Hook Fish Co, Blackbird Books, Outerlands, Palm City, and Yoga Beach. Enjoy the best coastal lifestyle in SF at 1278 La Playa.
